description: This source file provides implementation of functions related to SHA-1 collision detection and integration with Git, including initialization, finalization with collision attack handling, and update functions.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCInit(SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the SHA1 context with optional safe hash setting based on external macro.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCFinal(unsigned char hash[20],SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash and triggers a fatal error if a collision attack is detected.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX * ctx,const void * vdata,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Updates the SHA1 context with data, handling large data lengths by chunking.

ctags.name: git_SHA1DCUpdate
ctags.pattern: /^void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX *ctx, const void *vdata, unsigned long len)$/
